name: local-skill-exchange
description: Local Skill Exchange - MERN stack app for exchanging skills without money

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && node scripts/setup.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
